comments.text: the level's walking hook ($AE0B), run each frame the hero walks: the slopes. The character a row below his feet, a column ahead ($7F83), is looked at: walking right onto $6C or $6D, or left onto $86 or $87, he moves a unit across and a line up (three lines while the screen scrolls, $19), and the engine's own step is skipped (the PLAs drop its return), so he climbs the slope
facing left: the slope characters that rise to the left, $86 and $87
a line up, or three while the screen scrolls
the PLAs drop the walking routine's return, so the engine neither moves him nor sets him back on a character row

where the hook looks from the screen row under the hero, by the way he faces: $77 facing left (three rows down, a column behind), $7B facing right (three rows down, three columns on); the same values as level 4-1's table

object type 3, the drip (blue), level 4-1's with another splash sound; its shapes are 4-1's, which stay in memory below this file's sprites. It forms under the ceiling (shapes $98 to $9C, one every 8 frames), falls 4 lines a frame and splashes where it meets a wall (shapes $9D to $A0, one every 4 frames) with the sound $A1. Then it forms again where it started. It cannot be shot; touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which bursts it
forming: the next shape every 8 frames; after five, it falls (state 1) and its fall is measured from 0 ($BC06, $BC11)
falling (state 1): on the play area, the character under it ($BF6E, $BF87) is looked at; a wall makes it splash (state 2)
touches the hero? He is hurt; shielded or the wheel, the drip bursts into an explosion
4 lines down, and 4 more on the fall measured
splashing (state 2): the next shape every 4 frames
forms again: back up by the length of its fall, unseen ($FE), as a new drip; this also happens when it falls past Y 214. One that fell 200 lines or more is removed instead

object type 4, the bouncing ball (orange), level 4-1's type 8 under another number and shapes: rolls a unit a frame, turning round at walls, and bounces whenever it lands, 23 frames a bounce, with the sound $8B. Shot, or touched by the shielded hero, it bursts into a piece in every free slot that fly off at random, for 400 points; touching it otherwise hurts the hero
its first frame: its way from the state ($8286), its shape ($8288), orange, rolling (state 0)
a piece (state 1): a wall, or any of the weapons' characters ($D4 up), under it bursts it; otherwise it flies by its own random speeds; off the screen it is removed
the ball: shot?
touches the hero? He is hurt; shielded or the wheel, the ball bursts
every 6 frames the next of its five rolling shapes, by its way ($82A7, $82A2)
a wall ahead turns it round, with the sound $8B
a unit across; off the screen's sides it is removed; a wall two rows under it starts a bounce (23 frames) with the sound $8B
up and down by the table at $828A, read from the count down

bursts: an explosion in its place, and every free slot from 10 down a piece (type 4, state 1): shape $A6 or $A7, within 15 units and 31 lines of it, moving 0 to 3 units across and 0 to 7 lines up or down a frame, at random; 400 points
its first step by the state: -1, 1
its first shape by the state: $A1, $A5
the bounce's Y steps, read from 23 down: 8 lines up at first, then down up to 4
its rolling shapes going left: $A5 to $A1
going right: $A1 to $A5

object type 5, the bonus block: level 4-1's block reworked. Unseen until a shot finds it, then a block ($A8, yellow) the hero can stand on. While shots hit it, it flashes brown with the sound $A0 and every fifth frame of hits throws out a bonus symbol of a random kind (the four weapons, P, G, M or L) for 500 points; after 15 symbols the next destroys it, for 5,000 points. It does not move when shot. Jumping into it from below bumps it a little hop. The bonus symbols it throws are type 5 objects too, states 0 to 7
its first frame: state 10, 15 symbols to give ($BC69), 4 frames to the first, unseen ($FE), not hopping, the hero neither on it nor in it
states 9 and up: the block, yellow
shot while unseen: it shows itself ($A8, state 11)
shot while shown: brown with the sound $A0; every 5 frames of hits a symbol; with none left it is destroyed for 5,000 points, and the hero is off it
a symbol thrown out in a free slot: type 5 with a random kind 0 to 7 as its state, its shape and colour from $8449 and $8451, moving a unit left, right or not at all across, with 500 points

the hero is on a block ($0257) when any block's flag says so ($BCA0 for every slot), and in one ($0258) likewise ($BCAB), so several blocks can share the two engine flags; then its hop, if one is under way ($8429)

standing within 6 lines of its top he rides on it, his Y set by it; lower, inside it, his jump stops as at a ceiling and, unless it is hopping, it hops (9 frames, $BC95); away from it, its flags are cleared
a thrown symbol (states 0 to 7): flies up and falls by the table at $8459 for 40 frames, then becomes a bonus symbol of its kind (type 2, new)
the hop: up and down by the table at $8440, read from 8 down, then over ($BC8A)

the thrown symbols' shapes by kind: $8C for the four weapons, then $8D to $90
their colours: red, green, blue and light blue for the weapons, yellow for P, white for G, M and L
a thrown symbol's Y steps, 40 of them: 8 lines up at first, then down up to 4

object type 6, the big flier (white): four sprites in a square ($A9 to $C0) beating its wings, only one at a time ($BCC1). It flies across at the hero's height, turning round when 40 units past him and flying a unit faster each time, up to 3; its wings beat faster at random as it flies. It takes 25 energy of shots; destroyed, its four parts and up to nine more explosions round it go off, with 5,000 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it

its first frame: removed if a flier is on already; otherwise three more free slots for its quarters (none: it is removed), facing the hero, at their places ($8716, $871A), 25 energy, its wings every 8 frames, a unit a frame

object type 7, the moth (yellow, $C1 to $CC): flutters about at random, 0 to 2 units across and 0 to 4 lines up or down a frame, each way kept for 1 to 31 frames, bouncing off walls and the screen's edges. Each moth splits once, 65 frames after it appears, or later while no slot is free: a new moth in a free slot at its place, which splits in its turn, so they multiply until the slots run out. Shot, it explodes for 200 points; touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it

its first frame: yellow, its wings at step 9, one split to come in 64 frames ($BD0F, $BD04), random times to its first turns ($BCC2, and that EOR 13 for $BCCD), 2 units a frame towards the hero's side and a random way up or down ($8902)
